notes: the two branches meet at Shu'ba («قالا حدثنا شعبة»); «أبي» is Ubayd Allah's father, named only by relation (rule 7)
«بهذا الإسناد في حديث معاذ» closes both routes as a back_reference; no previous report is supplied, so nothing is inherited
«وفي حديث محمد بن جعفر» is a wording variant with the same transmitters, so it is not a group
«- يعني ابن جعفر -» is an editor gloss, left out
